lens: evidence integrity, privacy, and safe action
scope: XS-RETENTION-01 retention slice from browser handoff through backend receipt, readback, expiry, purge, retry, and deletion lineage
strengths: The accepted transport matrix is explicit in extension code, Web validation, backend policy resolution, and tests; unsupported image and full-source claims fail closed.
Receipts return requested and effective policy, source-access state and reason, lifecycle timestamps, and ordered lineage under account scope.
Ephemeral source content is purged in the production review-completion transaction without a second human delete, and replay bodies are scrubbed so retries cannot restore it.
Evidence-crop retention stores only the reviewed selected text, enforces a bounded deadline, removes source quotes after expiry, and preserves non-source derived proposal state.
Proposal, confirmed state, action authority, deletion lineage, and observed external outcome remain distinct; the direct proof records zero external writes.
missing_evidence: This round does not verify backup-system or third-party vendor erasure because the local backend slice has no configured backup or vendor source store.
Visible-tab image lifecycle proof is intentionally absent because that transport is rejected before Submit and independently rejected by the Web API.
open_questions: XS-CAPTURE-01 remains an active out-of-scope release veto; this retention pass does not claim a real Chrome toolbar capture grant.
A future visible-tab implementation will need a governed reviewed-image asset store and a new safety review before any mode can be accepted.

identity_speaker_binding.evidence: Frozen core fixtures and the fresh backend evaluator preserve explicit account, candidate, assignment, and ambiguity boundaries.

provenance.evidence: Capture, source locator, purpose, policy, receipt, lifecycle event, deletion ID, proposal, and versioned contract remain separately traceable.

uncertainty_conflict.evidence: The frozen 8-case core evaluation continues to pass abstention, ambiguity, conflict, and no-action boundaries.

user_authorization.evidence: Retention choice is explicit before handoff; the Web workspace proof reports zero confirmed assertions and no action authority.

external_write_integrity.evidence: The backend and authenticated Web evidence report no contact, calendar, message, ATS, or CRM writes.

privacy_lifecycle.evidence: Docker PostgreSQL proof directly covers minimization, account scope, effective deadlines, review-triggered purge, deadline purge, replay scrubbing, readback, and deletion lineage.

sensitive_inference_boundary.evidence: The unchanged core evaluator continues to enforce proposal-only candidate momentum without quality, personality, protected-trait, or acceptance-probability inference.

evaluator_reliability.evidence: Atomic unit, integration, extension, Web, frozen-core, Docker lifecycle, and authenticated browser/API evidence agree after three disclosed evidence-driven corrections.
